item.title: Daycare Staff Onboarding 2026: Background Checks + First 30 Days
item.description: Daycare staff onboarding is the single most common inspection fail category across U.S. state licensing agencies. Not because directors don’t care about compliance — they do — but because onboarding involves a multi-step, multi-jurisdictional paperwork trail that has to land in a specific order, and one missing document can void the entire hire. A first-year daycare director juggling licensing, enrollment, and parent communication often gets to the “hire staff” phase with no protocol, hires quickly to fill a schedule gap, and discovers the missing FBI clearance during the next state visit.
